visual.general_description: Stacked column chart of pregnancy-specific time in range, above range and below range for each of three trimesters.
visual.detailed_description: Stacked column chart on a white background with three vertical columns labelled I TRIMESTER, II TRIMESTER and III TRIMESTER along the bottom. Each column is divided into a yellow top segment, a large green middle segment and one or two red segments at the base; the base of the first column carries a bright red segment and a thinner dark red segment, the second column a red base segment with a thin lower red edge, and the third column a single thin red base segment. Row labels on the left read "TAR >140 mg/dL", "TIR (63-140 mg/dL)", "TBR <63 mg/dL" and "TBR <54 mg/dL". Bold numbers printed to the right of each column give the segment values: 24, 68, 6 and 2 for the first column, 19, 74, 6 and 1 for the second, and 7, 89 and 4 for the third. A legend at the bottom shows a dark red square "% psTBR Very Low", a red square "% psTBR Low", a green square "%psTIR" and a yellow square "%psTAR". There is no numeric y-axis, no gridlines and no panel letters. Qualitatively the yellow time-above-range segment becomes smaller and the green time-in-range segment larger from the first to the third column.
